tools.name: search_guide_articles
tools.description: Search udansa's editorial content: about 1,400 dance guide articles (learning to dance, finding a dance partner, wedding dance, dance styles, etiquette, health), city guides and dance style pages, in 40 languages. Returns titles, short summaries and page URLs; read one with read_page_text.

tools.name: read_page_text
tools.description: Read the text of a udansa content page (guide article, city or dance style page, terms, privacy or cancellation policy, about us) as plain sections plus its FAQ.
